content.title: About
content.content: Crisp "Peach" is a crunchy dried snack made from whole peaches, dried at low temperature. The snack retains the natural aroma and sweetness of ripe peach, offering a light texture and bright fruit flavor.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Peaches belong to the Rosaceae family and are relatives of plums, cherries, and apricots.
Low‑temperature drying preserves up to 90 % of vitamin C, which is usually lost in conventional drying.
Crisp "Peach" contains no added sugar – the sweetness is completely natural.
The snack is easy to transport and store, requiring no refrigeration.
Natural peaches contain more than 200 bioactive compounds, many of which remain in the product.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Peaches are a good source of vitamin C, which supports immunity and collagen synthesis.

items.title: Contains beta‑carotene
items.content: Beta‑carotene converts to vitamin A, beneficial for vision and skin health.

items.title: Provides dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber aids normal digestion and promotes a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The snack is virtually fat‑free, making it suitable for low‑calorie diets.

items.title: Antioxidant compounds
items.content: Peaches contain flavonoids that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Peach allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to peaches, ranging from skin rashes to severe symptoms.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although no added sugar is present, natural sugars may be a concern for people with diabetes; moderation is advised.

items.title: Food additives
items.content: During long storage, antioxidants may be used; check the label for unwanted additives.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Crisp "Peach" is convenient as a standalone snack, added to granola, yogurt, salads, or used in baking for a fruity note.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in an airtight package in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. For extended storage, keep refrigerated to preserve aroma and crunch.
